runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs
runs.emptyBody: Once you export an agent to CI, every automated review shows up here.
runs.degraded: GitHub Actions is unavailable or rate-limited, so this refresh was skipped. Showing previously ingested runs.

preview.runnerPlaceholder: Bundled agent runner ({size}) — too large to display. Shipped as-is, read-only.
preview.editHint: Only the workflow file can be edited. Your edits are used when you install.

configure.secretsHint: Add any missing secret to the repository’s Actions secrets before the workflow runs. DevDigest does not check the repository’s secrets.
configure.blockMerge: To block merges: set Fail CI on so the run exits non-zero, then add a required status check in the repo’s branch protection. No GitHub App needed.

install.repoHint: owner/name — the repository to add the workflow to
install.openPrCard: Opens a PR in {repo} titled “{title}” with the {count} generated files, from the devdigest/ci branch.
install.zipCard: Downloads a zip of the {count} generated files. No PR is opened and nothing is installed.
install.zipOnly: Only GitHub Actions can open a PR; other targets are delivered as a zip.

ciTab.heading: CI deployment
ciTab.activeIn: Active in {count, plural, one {# repo} other {# repos}}
ciTab.failOnHint: The run exits non-zero (and requests changes) at this severity. Add a required status check in branch protection to block merges.
ciTab.empty: Not deployed to CI yet. Use “Add to CI” to open a PR that adds the workflow and agent config.
ciTab.degraded: GitHub Actions is unavailable or rate-limited — showing previously ingested runs.
ciTab.historyEmpty: No CI runs for this repository yet.
